details:
Description

It's happened often after the recent steamvr update. It messes with hand tracking in a way where it can still read my hands, but it won't do the animations anymore, nor can i use any of the toggles or even open my main menu hand tracking. I've noticed it fixes itself when i resttart my game though. Weird, annoying to keep doing, but for now that's the only fix.  Thank you for your time, have a great rest of your day.

Reproduction Steps

I only noticed after it's happened like 10 times, but it mainly happens only after I put my controllers down for a small amount of time and my hand tracking turns on automatically, which before I didn't mind because I set it up that way. It basically knows my hand tracking is on, but it won't read my gestures or commands.

Details

- Category: Other

- Frequency: Often
